response.policy: Positive reported bins only, summed once per cell over the declared window. Unreported/unsurveyed cells are not zeros. Recorded source records, not abundance, occupancy or validated absence.
response.deduplication: Stable SOURCE_RECORD_ID upsert within source. No proximity-only cross-source merge. Cross-source duplicate encounters remain possible.
response.coverage: Opportunistic reports and configured research archives, not a complete survey. Sparse counts contain only positive record counts; a missing cell/bin is unknown/no report, never biological absence or surveyed zero. No effort denominator supplied. Unlocated/out-of-envelope and source-QC records are excluded with audit. Unknown time records appear only All time. Historical corrections outside refreshed windows are not guaranteed.
response.rights: LOCAL INTERNAL USE ONLY. Provider UNKNOWN/INTERNAL_ONLY settings preserved. Exact sensitive/restricted locations remain local. No redistribution or publication rights established. CWR derivative use requires written approval; no approval obtained.
response.temporalPolicy: Half-open actual source time bounds. Timestamp lexical precision is representation precision, not clock accuracy. Native day spans source-local midnight to next midnight. UTC bins require whole-interval containment; unknown timezone/date cannot enter dated UTC bins. Weeks start Monday 00:00 UTC; months/years are calendar UTC. No synthetic noon used. GBIF date-only/offset-free timestamps have unknown source timezone; generic configured UTC is not publisher evidence. Such rows keep native_date but enter only All time. Known native dates outside the requested calendar window are excluded even when UTC support is unknown.
response.analysisFrame: Positive recorded native cells only; source-wide predictor rows outside this frame are reported separately, never absence labels.
